Title: Log Analytics Agent for Windows 10.20.18001 now available

Body.Content:
The Log Analytics Agent for Windows June 2019 release is now available. This release contains stability and reliability improvements.

If you have installed the Log Analytics agent for Windows by using Azure extensions and have automatic extension updates turned on, this update will be automatically applied in version 1.0.18001. Otherwise, you can manually download the latest agent version, 10.20.18001, from the Advanced Settings blade in your Log Analytics workspace, or by following instructions here. 

For more information, see the agent release notes.
